name: Mango Sticky Rice
description: Sweet coconut-infused sticky rice served alongside slices of ripe fresh mango, drizzled with rich coconut cream.

name: Tonkotsu Ramen
description: Rich, creamy pork-bone broth ramen topped with chashu pork belly, soft-boiled egg, nori, and bamboo shoots.

name: Chicken Tikka Masala
description: Tender grilled chicken in a velvety tomato-cream sauce perfumed with garam masala, ginger, and garlic.

name: Tacos al Pastor
description: Marinated spit-roasted pork shaved onto corn tortillas, topped with pineapple, cilantro, and onion.

name: Bibimbap
description: A colorful Korean bowl of steamed rice topped with sauteed vegetables, beef, a fried egg, and gochujang chili paste.

name: Coq au Vin
description: Classic French braised chicken slow-cooked in red wine with lardons, mushrooms, pearl onions, and fresh thyme.

name: Margherita Pizza
description: Thin-crust Neapolitan pizza with San Marzano tomato sauce, fresh mozzarella, and basil leaves, baked in a wood-fired oven.

name: Lamb Shawarma
description: Spiced slow-roasted lamb shaved from a vertical spit, wrapped in flatbread with garlic sauce, vegetables, and fresh herbs.

name: Pho Bo
description: Vietnamese aromatic beef broth soup with rice noodles, thinly sliced beef, bean sprouts, fresh herbs, and a squeeze of lime.

name: Nasi Goreng
description: Indonesian wok-fried rice seasoned with kecap manis and shrimp paste, topped with a fried egg and prawn crackers.

name: Moussaka
description: Layers of roasted eggplant, spiced ground lamb, and creamy bechamel sauce baked until golden.

name: Beef Bulgogi
description: Thin slices of marinated beef grilled over charcoal with a sweet-savory soy-sesame glaze, served with lettuce wraps and kimchi.

name: Butter Chicken
description: Succulent chicken pieces simmered in a mildly spiced tomato-butter-cream sauce, best served with garlic naan or basmati rice.

name: Feijoada
description: A hearty Brazilian black bean stew slow-cooked with smoked pork sausage, ribs, and dried beef, served with rice and farofa.

name: Injera with Doro Wat
description: Spongy sourdough flatbread served with deeply spiced Ethiopian chicken stew and hard-boiled eggs in berbere sauce.

name: Croissant
description: A buttery, flaky, laminated pastry with a crisp golden exterior and soft layered interior.

name: Pad Thai
description: Stir-fried rice noodles with shrimp, tofu, egg, and bean sprouts, tossed in tamarind-fish sauce and finished with crushed peanuts and lime.

name: Churros con Chocolate
description: Deep-fried choux pastry sticks dusted with cinnamon sugar, served with thick dark chocolate dipping sauce.

name: Jollof Rice
description: One-pot West African party rice cooked in a smoky tomato-pepper sauce with onions and spices, often served with fried plantains.

name: Peking Duck
description: Lacquered whole duck roasted until the skin is paper-thin and crackling, served with thin pancakes, hoisin sauce, cucumber, and spring onion.

name: Smashed Avocado Toast
description: Thick sourdough toast topped with seasoned smashed avocado, chilli flakes, lemon zest, and a poached egg.

name: Pierogi Ruskie
description: Soft boiled dumplings stuffed with mashed potato and farmers cheese, pan-fried in butter and topped with crispy fried onions and sour cream.

name: Salmon Nigiri
description: Hand-pressed ovals of vinegared sushi rice topped with thin slices of buttery raw salmon, brushed with a touch of soy. Simple, clean, and designed to showcase the fish's natural richness.

name: Maguro Sashimi
description: Paper-thin slices of deep-red bluefin tuna, served chilled with grated wasabi, pickled ginger, and a pour of tamari soy sauce. Pure fish, no rice.

name: Ebi Tempura
description: Large black tiger prawns dipped in an ice-cold flour batter and flash-fried into a lacy, golden crust. Served with grated daikon and a tentsuyu dipping sauce.

name: Kitsune Udon
description: Thick, pillowy wheat noodles in a clear dashi and soy broth, topped with a sheet of sweet-simmered aburaage tofu and sliced scallion. Warming and comforting.

name: Zaru Soba
description: Chilled buckwheat noodles drained on a bamboo mat, dipped bite by bite into a cold tsuyu sauce with wasabi, scallion, and a hint of nori. Clean and nutty.

name: Yakitori Negima
description: Skewered chunks of juicy chicken thigh alternated with charred scallion, grilled over binchotan charcoal and glazed with sweet-savory tare sauce.

name: Osaka Okonomiyaki
description: A savory cabbage pancake bound with dashi-spiked batter and pork belly, griddled then slathered with okonomi sauce, Kewpie mayo, bonito flakes, and aonori.

name: Takoyaki
description: Molten spheres of wheat batter stuffed with a chunk of octopus, pickled ginger, and scallion, cooked in a special cast-iron mold and topped with dancing bonito flakes.

name: Tonkatsu
description: A thick-cut pork loin dredged in panko and deep-fried to a shatteringly crisp golden brown, sliced and served with shredded cabbage and tangy tonkatsu sauce.

name: Yaki Gyoza
description: Half-moon dumplings filled with minced pork, cabbage, garlic, and ginger, pan-seared to a crisp bottom then steamed through. Dipped in soy-vinegar-chili oil.

name: Oyakodon
description: A parent-and-child rice bowl of chicken thigh and onion simmered in dashi, soy, and mirin, then bound together with just-set beaten egg and spooned over hot rice.

name: Gyudon
description: Paper-thin slices of beef and onion simmered in a sweet soy-dashi broth, piled over fluffy short-grain rice and often topped with a raw egg yolk and pickled ginger.

name: Umeboshi Onigiri
description: A triangular hand-pressed rice ball with a salty-sour pickled plum hidden in the center, wrapped in a crisp sheet of nori. A classic Japanese lunchbox staple.

name: Chicken Karaage
description: Bite-sized pieces of chicken thigh marinated in soy, sake, ginger, and garlic, dredged in potato starch, and double-fried to an exceptionally crunchy exterior.

name: Japanese Curry Rice
description: A thick, mildly sweet curry sauce with tender beef or pork, carrots, onions, and potatoes, ladled generously over a bed of steamed white rice.

name: Strawberry Daifuku
description: A pillowy round of glutinous rice mochi wrapped around a whole fresh strawberry and a layer of sweet white bean paste. Soft, chewy, and lightly sweet.

name: Matcha Tiramisu
description: Ladyfingers soaked in bitter matcha tea and layered with sweetened mascarpone cream, dusted generously with ceremonial-grade matcha powder on top.

name: Chawanmushi
description: A silky, savory egg custard steamed in a cup with dashi, soy, and mirin, hiding gems of chicken, shrimp, shiitake, and ginkgo at the bottom.

name: Unadon
description: Fillets of freshwater eel grilled over charcoal and lacquered with a sweet-savory kabayaki glaze of soy, mirin, sake, and sugar, served over hot rice with sansho pepper.

name: Miso Soup
description: A warming bowl of dashi broth whisked with fermented soybean miso, garnished with silken tofu cubes, wakame seaweed, and chopped scallion.

name: Tteokbokki
description: Chewy cylindrical rice cakes and fish cake simmered in a fiery, slightly sweet gochujang-based sauce with scallion. A beloved Seoul street-food staple.

name: Kimchi Jjigae
description: A bubbling stew of well-aged sour kimchi, pork belly, silken tofu, and onion simmered in a spicy red broth. Best eaten straight from the earthenware pot with rice.

name: Japchae
description: Chewy sweet potato glass noodles stir-fried with julienned carrots, spinach, onion, shiitake, and thin beef strips, seasoned with soy, sesame oil, and a little sugar.

name: Samgyeopsal
description: Thick slabs of unseasoned pork belly grilled tableside over charcoal, wrapped in perilla or lettuce leaves with ssamjang, garlic, kimchi, and rice.

name: Galbi
description: Butterflied beef short ribs marinated in a sweet-savory sauce of soy, Asian pear, garlic, sesame, and mirin, then grilled over open flame until caramelized.

name: Sundubu Jjigae
description: A furiously bubbling stew of silken uncurdled tofu, clams, gochugaru, garlic, and a raw egg cracked in at the last moment, served in a hot stone bowl.

name: Kimbap
description: Seasoned rice and a rainbow of fillings like egg, pickled radish, spinach, carrot, burdock, and ham, rolled up in a sheet of nori and sliced into rounds.

name: Haemul Pajeon
description: A crispy, golden pancake packed with green onions, squid, shrimp, and mussels in a lightly seasoned flour-egg batter. Served with a soy-vinegar dipping sauce.

name: Patbingsu
description: A towering mound of fluffy shaved milk ice crowned with sweet red bean, chewy rice cake bits, condensed milk, and fruit. A beloved Korean summer dessert.

name: Dakgalbi
description: Chunks of chicken thigh with cabbage, sweet potato, and rice cake stir-fried on a large pan in a spicy gochujang-chili paste marinade, often topped with melty cheese.

name: Yangnyeom Chicken
description: Double-fried chicken wings and drumettes with an impossibly thin, crunchy crust, tossed in a glossy sweet-spicy gochujang glaze with garlic and sesame seeds.

name: Mapo Tofu
description: Silken tofu cubes simmered in a mouth-numbing, fiery sauce of fermented doubanjiang, ground pork, Sichuan peppercorns, chili oil, and scallion. Served over rice.

name: Xiao Long Bao
description: Delicate Shanghainese soup dumplings pleated with thin wheat skin, filled with seasoned pork and a molten pocket of savory aspic broth that releases on the first bite.

name: Kung Pao Chicken
description: Diced chicken stir-fried at high heat with dried red chilies, Sichuan peppercorns, scallion, and crunchy roasted peanuts in a tangy-sweet black vinegar sauce.

name: Sweet and Sour Pork
description: Crispy battered pork chunks tossed with pineapple, bell pepper, and onion in a glossy red-tinged sauce of vinegar, ketchup, and sugar. A Cantonese classic.

name: Sichuan Hot Pot
description: A bubbling cauldron of chili- and Sichuan-peppercorn-infused broth, for dipping thinly sliced beef, lamb, mushrooms, tofu, and noodles at the table.

name: Har Gow
description: Translucent, pleated wheat-and-tapioca-starch dumplings steamed in bamboo baskets, revealing whole plump shrimp and bits of bamboo shoot inside.

name: Lanzhou Beef Lamian
description: Freshly hand-pulled wheat noodles served in a clear, aromatic beef-bone broth with thin slices of braised beef, white radish, chili oil, and fresh cilantro.

name: Dan Dan Noodles
description: Wheat noodles tossed in a pool of tingly chili oil, black vinegar, sesame paste, and preserved mustard stems, topped with crispy minced pork and scallion.

name: Char Siu
description: Strips of pork shoulder marinated in hoisin, maltose, five-spice, and fermented bean paste, then slow-roasted until deeply lacquered with caramelized edges.

name: Century Egg Congee
description: A silky, slow-simmered rice porridge enriched with shredded lean pork and jet-black, jellied century egg, garnished with ginger, scallion, and white pepper.

name: Cantonese Steamed Sea Bass
description: A whole fresh sea bass gently steamed with ginger and scallion, then finished with a sizzling pour of hot oil and a delicate soy-based sauce over the top.

name: Scallion Pancake
description: A flaky, pan-fried flatbread laminated with layers of dough, sesame oil, and finely chopped scallions, crispy outside and tender within.

name: Mongolian Beef
description: Velveted flank steak stir-fried with ginger, garlic, and green onion in a glossy brown sauce of soy, brown sugar, and hoisin, served over crispy rice noodles.

name: Hong Shao Rou
description: Pork belly cubes slowly braised in caramelized rock sugar, Shaoxing wine, dark soy, ginger, and star anise until meltingly tender with a glossy mahogany glaze.

name: Yu Xiang Eggplant
description: Long strips of silky eggplant tossed in a fish-fragrant Sichuan sauce of pickled chilies, garlic, ginger, vinegar, and sugar, despite containing no fish at all.

name: Taiwanese Beef Noodle Soup
description: Wheat noodles in a deeply spiced broth of braised beef shank and tendon, doubanjiang, star anise, and tomatoes, topped with pickled mustard greens and scallion.

name: Brown Sugar Bubble Tea
description: Iced milk tea streaked with caramelized brown sugar syrup and loaded with warm, chewy tapioca pearls that sit at the bottom of the glass.

name: Lu Rou Fan
description: Finely minced pork belly braised in soy sauce, rice wine, rock sugar, shallots, and five-spice until rich and glossy, spooned over steamed rice with pickled radish.

name: Bo Lo Bao
description: A soft, slightly sweet Cantonese milk bun topped with a crunchy, cracked cookie-like crust resembling a pineapple pattern, often split and stuffed with a cold butter slab.

name: Aussie Meat Pie
description: A palm-sized hand pie of flaky shortcrust bottom and puff-pastry top encasing a rich gravy-laden filling of minced beef and onion. Eaten with a generous squirt of tomato sauce.

name: Lamington
description: Cubes of light butter sponge cake dipped in a thin chocolate icing, then rolled in fine desiccated coconut. Sometimes split and filled with whipped cream and jam.

name: Vegemite on Toast
description: Hot, buttered toast scraped with a thin layer of salty, umami-rich yeast-extract spread. A deeply divisive but iconic Australian breakfast.

name: Pavlova
description: A crisp-shelled, marshmallowy meringue base piled high with softly whipped cream and fresh seasonal fruit like kiwi, passionfruit, and berries.

name: Kokoda
description: Fiji's take on ceviche: fresh white fish cooked in lime juice, then dressed with creamy coconut milk, chili, onion, tomato, and cucumber. Served chilled.

name: Thai Green Curry
description: Fragrant coconut milk curry simmered with green chili paste, Thai basil, and tender chicken or eggplant. Served over jasmine rice to soak up the aromatic sauce.

name: Massaman Curry
description: Rich, mildly spicy curry with slow-braised beef, potatoes, peanuts, and warming spices like cardamom and cinnamon. A Thai-Muslim dish with Persian influence.

name: Tom Yum Goong
description: Hot and sour shrimp soup perfumed with lemongrass, galangal, kaffir lime leaves, and bird's eye chili. Bright, zingy, and deeply aromatic.

name: Tom Kha Gai
description: Silky coconut chicken soup with galangal, lemongrass, and lime, balanced with mushrooms and fish sauce. Creamy yet bright.

name: Som Tam
description: Pounded green papaya salad with lime, palm sugar, fish sauce, chili, and peanuts. Crunchy, tart, sweet, and fiery all at once.

name: Khao Soi
description: Northern Thai coconut curry noodle soup topped with crispy egg noodles, pickled mustard greens, and shallots. Rich, tangy, and textural.

name: Larb Gai
description: Isaan-style minced chicken salad tossed with toasted rice powder, lime juice, fish sauce, mint, and chili. Savory, citrusy, and fragrant.

name: Banh Mi
description: Crisp baguette layered with pate, cured meats, pickled daikon and carrots, cucumber, cilantro, and chili. A perfect French-Vietnamese sandwich.

name: Bun Cha
description: Hanoi-style grilled pork patties and belly served in a warm, sweet-tart fish sauce broth with rice vermicelli and fresh herbs.

name: Goi Cuon
description: Fresh Vietnamese summer rolls wrapped in rice paper with shrimp, pork, vermicelli, lettuce, and mint. Served with peanut hoisin dipping sauce.

name: Cao Lau
description: Hoi An specialty with thick, chewy noodles, char siu pork, crispy rice crackers, and greens in a light savory broth. Unique to central Vietnam.

name: Bun Bo Hue
description: Spicy beef and pork noodle soup from Hue, scented with lemongrass and shrimp paste, with thick round rice noodles and chili oil.

name: Com Tam
description: Broken rice plate topped with grilled marinated pork chop, shredded pork skin, steamed egg cake, and pickled vegetables with nuoc cham.

name: Ca Kho To
description: Vietnamese caramelized fish braised in a clay pot with fish sauce, palm sugar, black pepper, and chili. Deeply savory-sweet and sticky.

name: Beef Rendang
description: Slow-simmered West Sumatran beef braised for hours in coconut milk, lemongrass, galangal, turmeric leaf, and toasted coconut until dry and caramelized.

name: Gado Gado
description: Indonesian composed salad of blanched vegetables, boiled egg, tofu, tempeh, and potato, dressed in a spiced peanut sauce with kecap manis.

name: Sate Ayam
description: Skewered grilled chicken glazed with sweet soy sauce and served with a thick peanut sauce, sliced shallots, and lontong rice cakes.

name: Soto Betawi
description: Jakarta-style beef soup simmered in coconut milk and aromatics, enriched with tomato, potato, and crispy fried shallots. Rich and hearty.

name: Bakso
description: Indonesian beef meatball soup served in a clear savory broth with rice noodles, fried wontons, bok choy, and chili sauce.

name: Nasi Uduk
description: Fragrant Jakartan coconut rice steamed with pandan, lemongrass, and bay leaves, typically served with fried chicken, tempeh, and sambal.

name: Chicken Adobo
description: Filipino national dish of chicken braised in soy sauce, vinegar, garlic, bay leaves, and peppercorns until glossy and tangy-savory.

name: Sinigang na Baboy
description: Filipino sour pork soup soured with tamarind, packed with radish, okra, water spinach, and tomatoes. Bright, warming, and comforting.

name: Lechon
description: Whole spit-roasted pig rubbed with lemongrass, garlic, and salt until the skin shatters like glass. Centerpiece of Filipino fiestas.

name: Kare-Kare
description: Filipino oxtail and tripe stew in a thick peanut sauce colored with annatto, served with blanched vegetables and salty bagoong shrimp paste.

name: Sisig
description: Sizzling Kapampangan dish of chopped pig's head, liver, and ears seasoned with calamansi, chili, and onions, often topped with a raw egg.

name: Laksa Lemak
description: Malaysian coconut curry noodle soup with prawns, cockles, tofu puffs, and thick rice noodles in a rich spice-and-shrimp paste broth.

name: Char Kway Teow
description: Wide rice noodles wok-fried with prawns, Chinese sausage, egg, bean sprouts, and chives over fierce heat for smoky wok hei flavor.

name: Roti Canai
description: Flaky, pan-griddled flatbread with crisp crinkled edges, served with a bowl of dal or curry for dipping. Malaysia's beloved breakfast.

name: Hainanese Chicken Rice
description: Poached chicken served over fragrant rice cooked in chicken fat and pandan, with ginger-scallion sauce, chili, and dark soy.

name: Chili Crab
description: Whole mud crabs stir-fried in a sweet, spicy tomato-chili sauce thickened with egg ribbons, best eaten by dunking fried mantou buns.

name: Amok Trey
description: Cambodian steamed fish mousse flavored with kroeung curry paste, coconut cream, and noni leaf, traditionally served in a banana leaf cup.

name: Laap
description: Lao national dish of minced meat seasoned with toasted rice powder, fish sauce, lime, chili, and heaps of fresh herbs like mint and cilantro.

name: Mohinga
description: Burmese national breakfast of thin rice noodles in a rich catfish-lemongrass broth thickened with chickpea flour and topped with crispy fritters.

name: Hyderabadi Biryani
description: Dum-cooked layered rice with marinated mutton, saffron, fried onions, mint, and whole spices sealed under dough. Aromatic and deeply flavorful.

name: Dal Makhani
description: Punjabi black lentils and kidney beans slow-simmered overnight with butter, cream, tomatoes, and whole spices. Silky and deeply comforting.

name: Rogan Josh
description: Kashmiri lamb curry deep red from Kashmiri chilies and ratan jot, slow-braised with yogurt, fennel, and ginger. Aromatic, not fiery.

name: Garlic Naan
description: Soft leavened flatbread slapped onto a tandoor's wall until blistered, brushed with garlic butter and cilantro. Ideal for scooping curries.

name: Paneer Tikka
description: Cubes of paneer cheese marinated in yogurt, ginger, and tandoori spices, skewered with peppers and onions and char-grilled until smoky.

name: Chole Bhature
description: Punjabi street breakfast of spiced chickpea curry paired with puffed, deep-fried leavened bread. Bold, tangy, and filling.

name: Aloo Gobi
description: Dry curry of potatoes and cauliflower tempered with cumin, turmeric, ginger, and green chilies. A simple, home-style vegetarian staple.

name: Samosa
description: Triangular pastry with a crisp flour shell filled with spiced potatoes, peas, and cumin, deep-fried and served with tamarind and mint chutneys.

name: Pav Bhaji
description: Mumbai street classic of spiced mashed vegetable curry topped with butter, served with toasted buttery bread rolls and raw onion.

name: Masala Dosa
description: Giant, crisp fermented rice-and-lentil crepe folded over a spiced potato filling, served with coconut chutney and sambar.

name: Idli Sambar
description: Steamed fermented rice-and-lentil cakes served with a spicy-tangy lentil and vegetable stew and coconut chutney. Light and wholesome.

name: Medu Vada
description: Crisp, golden savory doughnuts of ground urad dal, black pepper, and curry leaves, deep-fried until crackling and served with chutney.

name: Kerala Fish Curry
description: Tangy coconut-milk fish curry with kokum or tamarind, mustard seeds, curry leaves, and green chilies. Brightly sour and fragrant.

name: Macher Jhol
description: Light Bengali fish curry in a turmeric-mustard gravy with potatoes, green chilies, and nigella seeds. Delicate yet deeply flavored.

name: Rasgulla
description: Spongy balls of fresh chhena cheese simmered in cardamom-scented sugar syrup until pillowy and dripping with sweetness. A Bengali classic.

name: Gulab Jamun
description: Deep-fried khoya milk dumplings soaked in warm rose-cardamom sugar syrup. Spongy, golden, and lavishly sweet.

name: Vada Pav
description: Mumbai's iconic spiced potato fritter tucked into a soft pav bun with garlic-chili chutney and fried green chilies. Fierce, cheap, addictive.

name: Dhokla
description: Steamed Gujarati sponge cake of fermented chickpea batter, tempered with mustard seeds, curry leaves, and green chilies. Light and tangy.

name: Pani Puri
description: Hollow crispy semolina shells filled with spiced potato, chickpeas, and tamarind chutney, then topped with tangy mint-coriander water.

name: Bhel Puri
description: Chaat of puffed rice tossed with sev, chopped onion, tomato, boiled potato, cilantro, tamarind and green chutneys. Crunchy, sweet-tart-spicy.

name: Jalebi
description: Spirals of fermented batter deep-fried until crunchy, then soaked in saffron-cardamom syrup. Eaten hot, sticky, and impossibly sweet.

name: Kulfi
description: Dense, slow-cooked Indian ice cream made from reduced milk, cardamom, saffron, and pistachios, frozen on sticks. Creamier than Western ice cream.

name: Nihari
description: Pakistani overnight-braised beef shank stew thickened with flour, slow-cooked with long pepper, ginger, and warming spices. Best with naan.

name: Haleem
description: Thick porridge of pounded wheat, lentils, and slow-cooked beef or mutton, finished with ginger, fried onions, and a squeeze of lemon.

name: Chapli Kebab
description: Peshawari flat beef patties spiced with coriander seed, pomegranate, green chili, and tomato, shallow-fried until lacy and crisp-edged.

name: Chicken Karahi
description: Chicken braised in a wok with tomatoes, green chilies, ginger, and cracked black pepper until the oil separates. Bright, punchy, fast.

name: Seekh Kebab
description: Spiced minced beef or mutton shaped around flat skewers and grilled over charcoal, served with mint chutney and onion rings.

name: Shorshe Ilish
description: Bangladeshi hilsa fish steamed or simmered in a pungent mustard paste with green chilies and mustard oil. A monsoon-season delicacy.

name: Panta Bhat
description: Bangladeshi fermented rice soaked overnight in water, served cool with fried hilsa, green chilies, onion, salt, and lime. A Noboborsho tradition.

name: Kacchi Biryani
description: Dhaka-style biryani with raw marinated mutton layered directly over partially cooked rice, saffron, potatoes, and ghee, then sealed and dum-cooked.

name: Kottu Roti
description: Sri Lankan street classic of chopped godamba roti stir-fried with egg, vegetables, chicken, and fiery curry sauce, accompanied by a rhythmic clanging on the griddle.

name: Egg Hoppers
description: Sri Lankan bowl-shaped fermented rice-and-coconut pancakes with a lacy crisp rim and soft middle, cradling a runny egg. Served with seeni sambol.

name: Fish Ambul Thiyal
description: Sri Lankan dry sour fish curry of tuna cured with goraka (gamboge), black pepper, cinnamon, and curry leaves. Intense, tangy, and preserve-like.

name: Chicken Momo
description: Himalayan steamed dumplings with a thin wheat wrapper encasing spiced minced chicken with ginger and garlic, served with tomato-sesame achar dip.

name: Kibbeh
description: Torpedo-shaped croquettes of bulgur wheat shell filled with spiced ground lamb, pine nuts, and caramelized onion, deep-fried until crisp.

name: Tabbouleh
description: Bright Levantine salad of finely chopped parsley, tomato, mint, and bulgur dressed with lemon juice and olive oil.

name: Fattoush
description: Crunchy salad of romaine, cucumber, radish, and tomato tossed with toasted pita chips and a tart sumac-lemon vinaigrette.

name: Hummus
description: Silky puree of chickpeas blended with tahini, lemon, and garlic, drizzled with olive oil and dusted with paprika.

name: Baba Ghanoush
description: Smoky dip of fire-charred eggplant whipped with tahini, lemon, and garlic, finished with parsley and olive oil.

name: Manakish Za'atar
description: Warm flatbread blanketed with a fragrant paste of za'atar, sumac, and olive oil, baked on a hot stone until blistered.

name: Iskender Kebab
description: Thin slices of spit-roasted lamb laid over torn pide bread, soaked in tomato sauce and brown butter, served with yogurt.

name: Doner Kebab
description: Stacked layers of marinated lamb or chicken shaved from a vertical rotisserie and wrapped in pide with tomato, onion, and sauce.

name: Borek
description: Layered pastry of paper-thin yufka dough wrapped around spiced feta and spinach, baked until golden and shatteringly crisp.

name: Manti
description: Tiny hand-folded dumplings stuffed with seasoned lamb, boiled and topped with garlicky yogurt and paprika-infused butter.

name: Lahmacun
description: Paper-thin flatbread topped with minced lamb, tomato, peppers, and parsley, blistered in a wood oven and rolled with lemon.

name: Baklava
description: Layers of buttered phyllo packed with crushed pistachios and walnuts, drenched in rose-scented sugar syrup.

name: Turkish Coffee
description: Unfiltered coffee brewed in a cezve with finely ground beans, producing a thick, foamy, intense cup traditionally served with a glass of water.

name: Kofte
description: Hand-shaped lamb and beef meatballs seasoned with cumin and parsley, grilled over charcoal and served with bulgur pilaf.

name: Ghormeh Sabzi
description: Iran's national herb stew of slow-simmered lamb, kidney beans, and fenugreek-rich sauteed greens with tangy dried limes.

name: Fesenjan
description: Rich Persian stew of chicken braised in a thick sauce of ground walnuts and tart pomegranate molasses.

name: Chelo Kabab
description: Skewers of saffron-marinated ground lamb or beef grilled over flame and served over buttery basmati rice with charred tomato.

name: Tahdig
description: The prized crisp golden crust of basmati rice formed at the bottom of the pot, often layered with yogurt, saffron, or thin lavash.

name: Falafel
description: Deep-fried balls of ground chickpeas, herbs, and cumin with a shatteringly crisp exterior and fluffy green interior.

name: Sabich
description: Pita stuffed with fried eggplant, hard-boiled egg, Israeli salad, tahini, amba mango pickle, and parsley.

name: Shakshuka
description: Eggs poached in a bubbling skillet of spiced tomato and red pepper stew, studded with cumin, paprika, and feta crumbles.

name: Muhammara
description: Smoky Syrian dip of roasted red peppers, toasted walnuts, pomegranate molasses, and Aleppo pepper-spiced breadcrumbs.

name: Fatteh
description: Layered breakfast of torn toasted pita topped with chickpeas, garlicky yogurt, tahini, and a drizzle of sizzling pine nut butter.

name: Machboos
description: Emirati spiced rice dish cooked with saffron, loomi dried lime, cardamom, and tender chicken or lamb.

name: Kabsa
description: Saudi national rice dish steamed with chicken or lamb, whole black limes, cardamom, and a warm blend of kabsa spices.

name: Egusi Soup
description: Thick Nigerian stew of ground melon seeds simmered with leafy greens, palm oil, smoked fish, and assorted meats.

name: Suya
description: Nigerian street-style beef skewers coated in yaji, a smoky peanut and chili spice blend, grilled over open flame.

name: Puff Puff
description: Pillowy deep-fried dough balls of yeasted batter dusted with sugar, golden outside and feather-light within.

name: Kitfo
description: Ethiopian delicacy of minced raw beef mixed with niter kibbeh spiced butter and mitmita chili blend, served with injera.

name: Shiro
description: Smooth Ethiopian stew of ground chickpea or broad bean flour simmered with berbere spices, onion, and garlic, scooped up with injera.

name: Tibs
description: Ethiopian sauteed cubes of beef or lamb sizzled with onion, rosemary, jalapeno, and niter kibbeh, served on injera.

name: Chicken Tagine with Preserved Lemon
description: Moroccan clay-pot stew of chicken slow-braised with preserved lemons, green olives, saffron, ginger, and cilantro.

name: Pastilla
